evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'Do you have about five to ten minutes to go over that?' but never frames the time-boxed promise or waits for a yes before pivoting to perks.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks 'do you have any questions or concerns you would like answered on this call besides pricing' — but this comes after already establishing the move details in the greeting, so it's mid-discovery rather than upfront.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides hourly rate ($222 for two movers and 26-foot truck) and a typical time range (2.5 to 3.5 hours, budget $555–$777) personalized to the customer's 700 sq ft one-bedroom to 450 sq ft studio move.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep discloses no hidden fees (no service fee, no credit card fees), mentions two and a half hour minimum, and 15-minute increment prorating. Also states 'there is no deposit required to get on our schedule. And then there's also no charges or fees to change or cancel as well.'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep asks 'Would you like us to help you with your move on Saturday' plainly, with no built-in out.
evidence_quotes.booking_not_confirmed: Customer declines to book ('Can I get back to you on this?'), so rep offers callback options and two arrival windows (8:30–9:00 AM and 12:30–2:30 PM) but does not confirm a booking with date, phone, arrival window, crew size, addresses, and crew notes because the customer has not committed.

top_strength: Rep thoroughly gathered logistics details (property type, floor, rooms, walking distance, special items, destination) and delivered both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) with full transparency on terms.
coaching_note: Section 1 is missing the core quid pro quo framing—the rep never time-boxes the call or promises a 'quote you can depend on' and doesn't wait for a yes; Section 6 is entirely absent (no final concerns check, no catch-all); and Section 4 skips 'Does that feel fair?' with a silence hold, which costs real closing momentum on undecided prospects.
